text:
maria: hey team, first week! got my laptop + dock but running into two issues :sob:

maria: 1) my Mac keeps failing to connect to Corp-WiFi — it shows "Certificate verification failed: untrusted root" when I try to join.

maria: 2) the dongle that shipped is USB-A (ethernet + HDMI) but my laptop only has USB-C ports so it won’t sit on the dock. opened a ticket TKT-20684 but wanted to ask here too — who should I bug for a swap + any quick Wi-Fi tips? :wave:

sarah-onboarding: welcome maria!! :tada: pinging IT and ops. if you need anything urgent ping me DM and i’ll escalate.

derek-it: hey maria — welcome. i can take the ticket. can you paste the exact Wi‑Fi error message (you already did, thanks) and tell me your macOS version (Apple menu > About This Mac)? also can you attach a screenshot of the Join dialog when you get a chance.

maria: macOS 13.6.1 (just updated). screenshot attached in ticket. exact text in dialog: ```Certificate verification failed: untrusted root - Corp-WiFi-CA```

derek-it: thanks. quick troubleshooting steps to try now (non-destructive):
1) System Settings → Network → Wi-Fi → Advanced → forget "Corp-WiFi" then try re-join.
2) If that fails, open Keychain Access → select "System" keychain → search for "Corp-WiFi-CA". If it’s there, right-click → Get Info → Trust → set "When using this certificate" = Always Trust, then try reconnecting.
Command you can run and paste output here: ```/usr/bin/security find-certificate -a -c "Corp-WiFi-CA" -Z /Library/Keychains/System.keychain || echo no-cert-found```

maria: tried forget + rejoin, still same error. i ran the command and got: "no-cert-found"

derek-it: ah okay — looks like the CA cert didn't provision. we push onboarding profiles via MDM but sometimes enrollment misses. can you check System Settings → Profiles and see if "Redwood Device Enrollment" is present?

maria: profiles page is empty, no enrollment.

derek-it: that explains it. i'll trigger a re-enroll from the MDM and push the CA cert. give me a few minutes, i’ll update the ticket when done. you might also get a macOS prompt to allow the profile — accept it and then reboot is helpful.

ashley-ops: @derek-it fyi we have a spare USB-C -> Ethernet + USB-C HDMI dongle in the new hire kit locker on 3rd floor. maria, want me to leave it for pickup? locker #2 code 1289, please wipe it when done.

maria: yes please that would be amazing, thanks ashley!! i can swing by in ~30m. :pray:

derek-it: ok pushed MDM re-enroll, you should see a profile prompt in the next 5-10m. when it appears, accept and then try joining Corp-WiFi again. if it still fails, i’ll create an urgent swap for a native USB‑C dongle — ETA 2–3 business days.

maria: got the profile prompt, clicked accept, rebooting now.

maria: connected! :raised_hands: Corp-WiFi is working after reboot. thank you both. i’ll pick up the dongle from locker #2 on my way to stand-up.

derek-it: awesome — glad that fixed it. i’ve updated TKT-20684 with steps and resolution. closing once you confirm pickup or if you want us to ship the correct dongle instead.

maria: picked up and tested the USB‑C dongle from the locker, everything looks good. closing from my side. :thumbsup:
